meta.note: MVP vocabulary. 'description' summarises the real ISL sign in words. 'keyframes' are placeholder poses for the procedural mannequin (and Mixamo-named rigs); they approximate hand placement only and must not be presented as authentic ISL. 'clipName' is the animation clip to look for inside a real avatar GLB.
meta.poseFormat: keyframes[].pose maps a bone name (without the 'mixamorig' prefix) to [x, y, z] rotation in degrees relative to the bone's rest pose. 'RightFingers'/'LeftFingers' curl all four fingers. Conventions on the mannequin: Arm X negative = raise forward, Arm Z (right negative / left positive) = raise sideways, ForeArm X negative = bend elbow, Head X positive = nod down, Brows X negative = raise eyebrows.
